verdict.rationale: SendGrid offers event-driven building blocks that run unattended: the Event Webhook pushes delivery events to a URL you control, and Inbound Parse forwards incoming email to your endpoint. However, the automation logic itself must be built and hosted by the user, and Marketing Campaigns appears only as a title with no documented automation features. Missing for 10: native automation/workflow builder evidence, scheduled or triggered sends, documentation of autonomous background flows, independent corroboration.
